title: The customer answers and the case is resolved with an outcome
risk: A case is closed as resolved without a resolution or an outcome, so retention analytics and CSAT are built on fiction.
preconditions: A WAITING_CUSTOMER case CASE-T1-0005 for cust-a in namespace cd-resolve-*

steps.action: Ingest the customer reply and re-enter the case
steps.expected: the case leaves WAITING_CUSTOMER and continues from IN_PROGRESS rather than jumping straight to RESOLVED

steps.action: Resolve the case with code refund_approved and outcome ticket_resolved_fcr
steps.expected: state becomes RESOLVED with a resolution code, an outcome reference and a resolution timestamp

steps.action: Attempt to resolve the same case a second time with a different resolution code
steps.expected: the second resolution is refused and the first resolution remains authoritative

steps.action: Read the case-linked outcome and its evidence
steps.expected: the outcome row carries conversion_type ticket_resolved_fcr and references the case and its evidence record

assertions: The case reports RESOLVED with resolution code refund_approved and a linked outcome row
The reply re-entry passed through IN_PROGRESS instead of skipping states
A second resolution attempt leaves exactly one resolution record on the case
forbidden: Mark a case RESOLVED with no resolution code or outcome reference
Overwrite a recorded resolution with a later attempt
evidence: Case projection with resolution code, timestamps and outcome reference
Outcome row with conversion_type and its evidence linkage
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped case, resolution and outcome rows for cd-resolve-*; the refund artifact itself is not created offline
automation: Drive the real case skill with fixture replies; the resolution step is stubbed at the payment boundary only, and the assertion is on resolution plus outcome linkage, not on the state label.
